meta.title: Pricing — Pantra for Dental Practices | Solo, Solo Plus, Multi
meta.description: Pantra pricing: Solo €149/month, Solo Plus €349/month (Recommended), Multi for group practices. Multilingual, GDPR-compliant, DPA included.

header.title: Simple pricing. No surprises.
header.subtitle: Choose the plan that fits your practice. Upgrade or downgrade anytime. Cancel monthly, no commitment.

addons.heading: Extras you add whenever you need them.
addons.lang_desc: Per additional language (3rd, 4th, ...). Solo Plus already includes 2 languages of your choice. Available: TR, AR, ES, FR, RU, IT, PT.
addons.onboarding_desc: A personal visit from our founder at your practice. Full setup plus team training in 90 minutes.
addons.overage_desc: If you exceed your plan's monthly limit, extra conversations are billed on a pay-as-you-go basis.
addons.annual_desc: Pay 12 months upfront and get 2 months free. Available on request.

limits.heading: What counts as a "conversation"?
limits.p1: A conversation is a chat thread between a patient and Pantra. Whether it has 3 messages or 50, it counts as ONE conversation.
limits.p2: If the patient writes again after 30 minutes of inactivity, a new conversation begins.

faq.heading: Pricing questions.
faq.q1: What happens if I exceed the monthly limit?
faq.a1: Pantra notifies you immediately via Telegram and email. You have two options: (1) upgrade your plan, or (2) switch to pay-as-you-go billing (€0.15 per additional conversation). We never block the service without warning you first.
faq.a2: Yes. Upgrading from Solo to Solo Plus takes effect immediately, billed pro-rata. Downgrades apply from the next billing cycle. No penalties, no questions asked.
faq.q3: Is there a minimum contract term?
faq.a3: No. Monthly cancellation with 30 days' notice. If you choose annual prepayment (2 months free), that comes with a 12-month term.
faq.q4: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a4: SEPA direct debit (standard for German practices) or credit card (VISA, Mastercard). Monthly or annual invoicing, your choice.
faq.q5: How much does an extra language channel cost?
faq.a5: +€39/month per extra language. Solo Plus already includes 2 languages of your choice. A third language channel (e.g. Arabic after Turkish and Spanish) would be +€39/month. Volume discounts are available from 4 languages — just ask.
faq.a6: Our contract reserves the right to adjust prices by up to 8% per year, with 60 days' notice (standard for German B2B SaaS). Prepaying annually locks in your current price for 12 months.
faq.q7: Do you offer discounts for multiple practices or chains?
faq.a7: Yes. For 3+ practices under the same ownership, we offer custom enterprise pricing — please contact us for a quote.
faq.a8: Yes — 14 days free, no credit card, no installation. You try Pantra in the full Solo Plus configuration. After 14 days you'll automatically move to your chosen plan, or simply cancel — no strings attached.

trust.heading: Included in every plan.
trust.avv_desc: Data processing agreement ready to sign before your first contract.
trust.frankfurt_desc: Hosted in Frankfurt. Your data stays in Germany.
trust.sepa_desc: Just like any other German provider.
